STOP BUILDING
TITLES BY HAND.

One word-by-word title, built properly in Fusion, is a Text+ node, a Follower, eased keyframes, a glow chain and a motion-blur pass. That is most of an evening — for four seconds of screen time. Glyph Motions is that evening, already done, 180 times over.

01 / TIME

An evening’s work becomes a drag

Node tree, keyframes, easing, glow, motion blur — all built and tested already. You drag, you type your line, you are cutting again in under a minute.

02 / NO ROUND-TRIP

You never leave Resolve

No After Effects, no Dynamic Link, no re-export when the client changes one word. Everything happens on your own timeline, in your own colour space.

03 / NOT A VIDEO FILE

Real Fusion nodes, fully editable

Text, font, style, colour and speed are Inspector controls on the clip. Nothing is baked in, and the type stays razor sharp from 1080p to 4K and beyond.

04 / RETENTION

Words land on your voiceover

The entrance drops one word at a time with a 0.67 s gap — tuned to spoken cadence, not to a stock preset. The viewer reads at the speed you talk, so they stay.

05 / REVIEWED

Every title was scored, not dumped

The whole library was reviewed one by one. 33 were deleted for being boring or broken; 37 scored a perfect 3/3. You get the survivors, not the filler.

06 / KEEPS GROWING

Pay once. Keep getting updates

September added 15 new titles and October added 52 more — every existing owner got them free. Most template libraries charge you that again every single month.

A TITLE, THE OLD WAY

  • Build the node tree from scratch, every single time
  • Hand-key the easing so it does not look robotic
  • Fight the glow until it stops looking cheap
  • Client changes one word — you rebuild the timing
  • Or you pay a subscription, every month, forever

A TITLE, WITH GLYPH MOTIONS
